legend: Khaled is the CEO of a rapidly growing industrial empire. His company recently acquired $$$N$$$ new factories, and he has hired $$$N$$$ workers to operate them. Both the workers' homes and the factories are located along a long, straight highway, which can be represented as the $$$X$$$-axis.

The $$$i$$$-th worker lives at coordinate $$$x_i$$$, and the $$$j$$$-th factory is located at coordinate $$$y_j$$$. Khaled needs to assign exactly one worker to each factory so that no two workers are assigned to the same factory.

Khaled requires a "stable" assignment. An assignment is invalid if swapping two workers' factories strictly increases the sum of their squared travel distances. Formally, for any worker $$$i$$$ assigned to factory $$$a$$$ and worker $$$j$$$ assigned to factory $$$b$$$, the following condition must NOT hold:
Given the locations, help Khaled find any valid assignment satisfying his strict stability condition.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer $$$N$$$ ($$$1 \le N \le 3000$$$) — the number of workers and the number of factories.
The second line of each test case contains $$$N$$$ distinct integers $$$x_1, x_2, \dots, x_N$$$ ($$$-10^9 \le x_i \le 10^9$$$) — the coordinates of the workers.
The third line of each test case contains $$$N$$$ distinct integers $$$y_1, y_2, \dots, y_N$$$ ($$$-10^9 \le y_i \le 10^9$$$) — the coordinates of the factories.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$N$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$3000$$$.
output: For each test case, output a single line containing $$$N$$$ space-separated integers $$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_N$$$, where $$$p_i$$$ is the 1-based index of the factory assigned to the $$$i$$$-th worker.
If there are multiple valid assignments that satisfy Khaled's condition, you may output any of them.

legend: 哈立德是一个快速发展的工业帝国的首席执行官。他的公司最近收购了 $$$N$$$ 新工厂，并雇佣了 $$$N$$$ 工人来运营这些工厂。工人的住所和工厂都位于一条长而笔直的公路旁，这条公路可以用 $$$X$$$ 轴来表示。
$$$i$$$ 第一个工人住在 $$$x_i$$$ 坐标，$$$j$$$ 第一个工厂位于 $$$y_j$$$ 坐标。哈立德需要在每个工厂精确地分配一个工人，以确保不会有两个工人被分配到同一个工厂。
Khalid 需要一个 “稳定” 的分配。如果两个工人的工厂互换严格地增加了他们的行程距离平方和，则分配无效。从形式上讲，对于任何被分配到工厂 $$$a$$$ 的工人 $$$i$$$，以及被分配到工厂 $$$b$$$ 的工人 $$$j$$$，以下条件不得成立：
根据地点，帮助哈立德找到任何符合他严格稳定条件的有效任务。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $$$N$$$($$$1 \le N \le 3000$$$)——工人数量和工厂数量。
每个测试用例的第二行包含 $$$N$$$ 不同的整数 $$$x_1, x_2, \dots, x_N$$$($$$-10^9 \le x_i \le 10^9$$$)——工作量的坐标。
每个测试用例的第三行包含 $$$N$$$ 不同的整数 $$$y_1, y_2, \dots, y_N$$$($$$-10^9 \le y_i \le 10^9$$$)——工厂的坐标。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$N$$$ 之和不超过 $$$3000$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行，其中包含 $$$N$$$ 空格分隔整数 $$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_N$$$，其中 $$$p_i$$$ 是分配给 $$$i$$$ 第一个工人的工厂的基于 1 的索引。
如果有多个满足哈立德条件的有效分配，你可以输出其中任何一个。
